## Findings
- claim-1: The inspected 2024 full text defines \(\overline\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and states \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218]
- claim-2: For bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-3: Internal Claim 3: accepted task 292 supplies the full-coordinate integral tall-to-wide descent for every valid \(\varphi\), retaining all \(A_{\lambda,\theta}\); it is not an independently source-backed claim.
- claim-4: Internal Claim 4: using the generation above and accepted task 292, the homogeneous kernel of \(\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho\to J_v/A_+J_v\) vanishes. Hence \[ J_v/A_+J_v\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]. \]
## Strategy
Inspected sources:

- `doi:10.1112/jlms.12832`, SHA-256 `267a2f5…e2bbd`: it defines \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) integrally [lines 213–218: “\(\mathbb Z\)-linear basis” and “\(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\)”] and, for bigrassmannian \(v\) with \(i,j,a,b\) defined at lines 221–226, states lower-family generation/minimality [lines 228–235: “is minimally generated by” the family at lines 229–231]. Its valid-tuple hypotheses are [lines 301–304]:
  \[
  r<n,\quad a+j\le r,\quad a+i\le n-r,\quad b\le i,j,\quad N\le ab.
  \]
- The source converts a nonzero homogeneous syzygy to decomposable equations [lines 326–344], but does not independently establish the repaired full-coordinate descent.
- Accepted task 292 supplies that internal integral descent. The consequent kernel proof is recorded at `artifacts/internal-sources/2b115024c234b698f79f034f44a7c2dc1f1329f234fefddb8f5adc5d439434d4/artifact.txt@L77-L85`, and its conclusion at `@L88-L92`.

Thus no mathematical repair is required for the scoped certificate:
\[
J_v/A_+J_v\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
\]
Claims 3–4 are internal proofs using accepted task 292, not independently source-backed claims. No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) computation is used or scheduled.

## Gaps
The inspected 2024 source proves minimal generation, not the displayed indecomposables decomposition. Likewise, inspected `source-2` states the basic-ideal definition [source-2, lines 328–337] but omits that decomposition. This is a source limitation, not a gap in the accepted internal proof dependency.

## Next
None for this certificate. No parent-theorem or right-adjoined conclusion is asserted.
